title: Rav Chama bar Tuvia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Sanhedrin 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.52b.2-3) relates that Imarta daughter of Tali, a priest’s daughter, committed adultery; Rav Chama bar Tuvia surrounded her with bundles of vine shoots and burned her. Rav Yosef said: “He erred in two things,” etc. Hyman infers from this that he was the head of his town.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara records the incident and Rav Yosef’s two objections. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1354&lang=en) recounts both objections. Hyman infers from the incident that Rav Chama had authority in his town.
